rows.label: qst500109_msg0001
rows.name:
Mo-mo?! Are you the party
who opened the path to
Elpis Spirit Cavern?!

rows.label: qst500109_msg0002
rows.name:
I've wanted to meet you for so long,
mooo!

rows.label: qst500109_msg0003
rows.name:
Nanonano is the second son of the
Twelve Nopon Siblings in Avaritia
Trading Company, mo.

rows.label: qst500109_msg0004
rows.name:
Each sibling went a separate way to
find ingredients for a juice even
better than Twinklejuice, mo.

rows.label: qst500109_msg0005
rows.name:
You may already have met some of my
younger siblings scattered across
Alst, mo.

rows.label: qst500109_msg0006
rows.name:
There are still some you haven't met,
mo?!

rows.label: qst500109_msg0007
rows.name:
They're all out gathering juice
ingredients, so please find them, mo.

rows.label: qst500109_msg0008
rows.name:
Nanonano has gathered plenty of
ingredients, so it's time to return
to Avaritia Trading Company, mo.

rows.label: qst500109_msg0009
rows.name:
I can't wait to see what ingredients
everyone else gathered, mooo!

rows.label: qst500109_msg0010
rows.name:
If you have time, please visit the
Twelve Nopon Siblings in Avaritia
Trading Company, mooo!

rows.label: qst500109_msg0011
rows.name:
Mo-mo?! You've already met the others,
mo?

rows.label: qst500109_msg0012
rows.name:
You must have helped my younger
siblings a lot, mo.

rows.label: qst500109_msg0013
rows.name:
As thanks, I'll give you the Spoil
Apple I found here, mo.

rows.label: qst500109_msg0014
rows.name:
Now that Nanonano has thanked you in
person, it's time to return to
Avaritia Trading Company, mo.

rows.label: qst500109_msg0015
rows.name:
I can't wait to see what ingredients
everyone else gathered, mooo!

rows.label: qst500109_msg0016
rows.name:
If you have time, please visit
Twelve Nopon Siblings at
Avaritia Trading Company, mo~
